title.en: MALACAN ANG RESIDENCE OF THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES PROVIDING THAT THE VARIOUS ADMINISTRATIVE ACTIONS REQUIRED BY BXECUTIVE ORDIR NO. 209 DATED OCTOBER 19, 1956, AND REORGANI- ZATION PLAN NO. 60 RELATIVE TO PUBLIC UTILITILS REGULATION AND LAND TRANSPORTATION SHALL BE TAKEN ON OR BEFORE JANUARY 25, 1957.
